text_en: “Come, let us return to the Lord ; for it is he who has torn, and he will heal us; he has struck down, and he will bind us up.
text_cn: “来，我们回到上主那里去，因为他撕碎了我们，也必要治愈；他打伤了我们，也必要包扎。

text_en: After two days he will revive us; on the third day he will raise us up, that we may live before him.
text_cn: 两天后他必使我们复生，第三天他必使我们兴起，生活在他的慈颜下。

text_en: Let us know, let us press on to know the Lord ; his appearing is as sure as the dawn; he will come to us like the showers, like the spring rains that water the earth. ”
text_cn: 让我们认识上主，让我们努力认识上主！他定要像曙光一样出现，他要来到我们中间，有如秋雨，有如滋润田地的春雨。”

text_en: What shall I do with you, O Ephraim? What shall I do with you, O Judah? Your love is like a morning cloud, like the dew that goes away early.
text_cn: 厄弗辣因，我可对你作什么？犹大，我可对你作什么？因为你们的仁爱有如早晨的浮云，有如易于消逝的朝露。

text_en: Therefore I have hewn them by the prophets, I have killed them by the words of my mouth, and my judgment goes forth as the light.
text_cn: 因此，我藉先知们砍伐了他们，以我口中的言语杀戮了他们；我的裁判出现有如光明：

text_en: For I desire steadfast love and not sacrifice, the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.
text_cn: 因为我喜欢仁爱胜过祭献，喜欢人认识天主胜过全燔祭。

text_en: But at Adam they transgressed the covenant; there they dealt faithlessly with me.
text_cn: 但是他们在阿当就违犯了盟约，在那里已背叛了我。

text_en: Gilead is a city of evildoers, tracked with blood.
text_cn: 基肋阿得是座作恶者的城池，满了血迹。

text_en: As robbers lie in wait for someone, so the priests are banded together; they murder on the road to Shechem, they commit a monstrous crime.
text_cn: 一队司祭就如埋伏的强盗，在往舍根的路上行凶；的确，他们行了可耻的事。

text_en: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing; Ephraim’s whoredom is there, Israel is defiled.
text_cn: 在贝特耳我见了可恶的事：在那里厄弗辣因行了淫，以色列玷污了自己。

text_en: For you also, O Judah, a harvest is appointed. When I would restore the fortunes of my people,
text_cn: 当我转变我百姓的命运时，犹大啊！为你也注定了一个收割期。
